raw.title: TV, Video, Audio & Display Strategist
raw.excerpt: Who we are:Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.
raw.description:
Who we are:

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.


We support 100% remote work for this role!


We’d love to hear from you if:

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a TV, Video, Audio & Display (TVAD) Strategist, you will plan and improve full‑funnel TV, video, audio, and display programs to grow new customers, revenue, and LTV, while keeping efficiency on track. You’ll translate data and media learnings into clear decisions, run practical innovations, and scale what works. You’ll rely heavily on Bliss Point insights (Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Brand Equity, Creative Insights, Customer Insights) to focus investment where it performs best, and you’ll partner closely with Client Leadership, Media investment, Econometrics, Creative, and other channel teams (e.g. Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media) in your Pod. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric

  • Turn business goals into a clear TVAD plan across awareness / consideration / performance (CTV/OTT, online video, digital audio/podcasts, programmatic display, linear) and explain options and trade‑offs in plain language.

  • Lead day‑to‑day client strategy and execution; present growth‑focused updates and QBRs that connect media to business outcomes (revenue, CAC, LTV, incremental reach).

The Tinuiti Way

  • Pair strong TVAD craft (audience/data sources, inventory quality, frequency/overlap control, brand safety/attention) with growing multi‑channel understanding

  • Connect TVAD with Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media, CRM, and Creative to amplify growth, teach clients and teams, and codify playbooks.

Product‑Led

  • Use platform capabilities and optimization responsibly (e.g., DSP goal strategies, pacing, frequency, brand safety/verification); pilot safely, measure, then scale.

  • Apply Bliss Point insights to shape budgets and innovations (audience, inventory, formats, frequency strategy); provide structured feedback to improve tools.

Data & Measurement‑Driven

  • Design valid tests suited to TVAD (geo/lift or holdout where feasible; otherwise powered A/B or time‑series), define success thresholds up front, and keep a steady read cadence; forecast expected impact and risk.

  • Explain and advocate for Tinuiti's measurement and attribution framework to both internal and external senior stakeholders.

  • Explain model caveats when recommending changes; support the health of data/ops

Owner Mindset

  • Move fast, keep promises, and remove recurring sources of waste (e.g., unmanaged frequency, low‑quality inventory, overlap

  • Help your Pod adopt better ways of working.

Ways of working and values

  • Greatness attracts greatness:Keep improving your craft; embrace new tools and AI.

  • Clients grow, we grow: Focus on outcomes, evidence, and simple explanations.

  • Culture of ownership: Move fast, cut waste, and own the result end‑to‑end.

Professional & Technical Qualifications

  • Experience: 5–7 years managing TV/video/audio/display at scale (CTV/OTT/Linear, online video, digital audio/podcasts, programmatic display) with end‑to‑end ownership; or 5–7 years in analytical roles (e.g., finance/consulting) with strong media analytics exposure.

  • Technical: Familiar with DSPs/ad platforms, verification/IVT/viewability, audience/data usage, and frequency management; comfortable coordinating with publishers/PMPs/partners.

  • Measurement: Incrementality/lift and basic A/Bs; forecasting; ability to connect media to revenue, CAC, LTV, incremental reach/attention.

  • Data skills: Advanced Excel/Sheets; SQL familiarity preferred; GA4 and platform analytics; clean documentation and communication.

  • Strong communication: Client‑ready storytelling; clear expectation‑setting; effective partner to Econometrics, Creative, channel teams, and Client Leadership.

KPIs

  • Growth: Increase qualified reach/new‑household acquisition; revenue and LTV contribution from TVAD; incremental reach vs. other media.

  • Quality: Better attention/viewability/brand safety; improved frequency/overlap control.

  • Innovation: Plan and adopt a steady flow of practical innovations (audience/data, inventory quality, format/creative, frequency/quality), with decisions and learnings recorded.

  • Product/AI adoption: Responsible, heavier use of Bliss Point and platform optimization with proven, incremental impact.

  • Efficiency (guardrail): Hold or improve CAC/ROAS/CPx while growing profitable volume.

The hiring salary range for this role is $81,000 - $95,000. We also offer an incentive pay program (RevShare) comprising a monthly variable revenue payment opportunity and a discretionary annual performance bonus.

Hiring salaries are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, parity with other team members, and alignment with market data. We will provide more information on our benefits, incentive pay, and equity upon request. Disclosure as required by the Colorado Equal Pay for > Equal Work Act, C.R.S. § 8-5-101 et seq.

FLSA Classification: Exempt

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


Benefits:


Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a fully remote environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 20 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Healthcare: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability, Flex Spending Accounts

Retirement: Match up to 4% of your contributions at 100%

Perks and Wellness: Fringe, Forma, Unlimited Telemedicine and Teletherapy available at no cost, Thankful giving, Equity

Parental Leave: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of leave with 100% pay (partners 12 weeks) after the birth or adoption of a child.

Learning and Development: On-demand learning, mentorship program, leadership and management development programs and resources


Disclaimer: This description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this position. The actual duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may vary based on assignment or group. Tinuiti is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

raw.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach.

This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team.

What they're looking for

If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development.

You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy.

If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you.

The Details

As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas:

  • Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement.
  • User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals.
  • User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences.
  • Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing.
  • Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development.
  • Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation.

Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution
  • Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering
  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment
  • Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale
  • Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment
  • Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key

What to Expect from the Process

This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available.

Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there’s a fit.

About the Client

This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of.

The remote-first culture values autonomy, trust, and open communication. The team is always exploring new ideas, evolving their process, and building products that move the needle for their clients.

This position is remote and open to all candidates, but applicants based in New York City are prioritized for potential in-person collaboration.

WEX is a global commerce platform that has been simplifying the way businesses operate for over 40 years. Our purpose is simple: to reduce administrative burdens, streamline payments, and manage mobility. With a team of over 7,200 professionals across 16 countries.

Our specialties are employee benefits, business payments, and fleet/mobility solutions. We support more than 20 million SaaS accounts, 8 million Health Savings Accounts, and 19+ million vehicles worldwide. We're a growing company with a history of innovation and a focus on our customers, making this a great place to grow your career.

The WEX Summer Internship Program: Learn, Lead, and Make an Impact

Our 13-week paid internship program, running from late May to mid-August, is a chance for you to gain real-world experience and develop your skills. Recruiting begins in September and continues through November at our various locations across the U.S.

You won't just be a bystander; you'll work on impactful projects and contribute to WEX’s mission. We provide mentorship, professional development, and weekly learning experiences to help you build confidence and leadership skills. High-performing interns may even get the chance to lead their own initiatives.

We offer remote, hybrid, and onsite options for flexibility, and our goal is to bring top interns back full-time or offer them extended roles during the school year.

Imagine starting your career with a company that’s building what's next. Your future starts here.

About the Team/Role:As a Software Engineer Intern, you will work alongside engineers and Product Managers to build resilient backend systems and AI-integrated workflows. You will gain hands-on experience designing scalable APIs, working in cloud environments, and leveraging modern AI toolchains.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Develop Backend Services:Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and backend processing pipelines using C# or Java.

  • Database & Cloud Integration: Write efficient SQL queries for SQL Server and support deployments on Microsoft Azure.

  • AI-Integrated SDLC:Leverage modern AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, MCPs, AI APIs) for spec-driven development, rapid prototyping, and automated task execution.

  • Learn & Collaborate:Partner with senior engineers to apply best practices in microservices and message-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka).

Experience you'll bring:

  • Educational Foundation: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related field and will have completed at least your Sophomore year of school at the start of the internship.

  • Proficiency in C# (preferred) or Java, along with strong standard database skills (SQL / SQL Server).

  • Solid understanding of API design principles, backend processing architectures, and Microsoft Azure.

  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants or APIs (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, MCPs) to accelerate development.

  • Knowledge of event streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka) or messaging architectures is a plus.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $27.00 - $35.00

raw.excerpt: Jouw ambitieWil jij werken aan uitdagende spoorprojecten en een directe bijdrage leveren aan de duurzame mobiliteit van Nederland?
raw.description:
Jouw ambitie

Wil jij werken aan uitdagende spoorprojecten en een directe bijdrage leveren aan de duurzame mobiliteit van Nederland? Bij Dura Vermeer Railinfra krijg je de kans om complexe projecten van A tot Z te managen, met volop vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid, plezier, ontwikkelmogelijkheden en een team van specialisten om je heen.
Jouw rol

Als projectmanager ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de realisatie van projecten voor o.a. ProRail. Je zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt: van de voorbereiding en uitvoering tot en met de afronding. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek, planning, financiën en stakeholders, en weet teams te motiveren om samen de beste resultaten te behalen.
Wat je zoal doet

✅ Leiden en coördineren van multidisciplinaire projectteams;

✅ Afstemmen met opdrachtgevers zoals ProRail en andere stakeholders;

✅ Bewaken van planning, budget en kwaliteit;

✅ Signaleren van kansen en risico’s en hier proactief op inspelen;

✅ Zorgen voor een veilige en efficiënte uitvoering van het werk.

Requirements

Meer bij Dura Vermeer
Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit jij op je plekJe maakt onderdeel uit van de vakgroep Projectmanagement. De verschillende vakgroepen kenmerken zich door de drive om succes te hebben en gezamenlijk de projecten tot een goed einde te brengen. Wanneer je vragen hebt of tegen problemen aanloopt, dan staan je collega's klaar om je te helpen. Samen wordt er gekeken naar een ideale oplossing. Samenwerking en collegialiteit kenmerken de sfeer binnen Dura Vermeer Railinfra.

Wat we van jou verwachten

🔹 Een technische HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in civiele techniek of elektrotechniek;

🔹 Ruime ervaring in een verantwoordelijke projectmanagement functie in de bouw of rail- infra;

🔹 Kennis van contractvormen zoals UAV-GC;

🔹 Een proactieve en oplossingsgerichte mindset;

🔹 Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een talent voor samenwerken en stakeholdermanagement;

Wat wij bieden

✔ Een goed salaris afhankelijk van de meegebrachte kennis, niveau en werkervaring beginnend bij € 7.025,- tot € 8.781,- bruto per 4 weken en dus 13 maal per jaar!;

✔ 43 vrije dagen volgens de Rail CAO, volop ruimte voor een goede werk-privébalans;

✔ Een leaseauto en alle tools die je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen;

✔ Uitgebreide ontwikkelmogelijkheden: trainingen, opleidingen en doorgroeikansen;

✔ Een team van gedreven professionals met wie je samen de mooiste spoorprojecten realiseert;

Maak impact op de spoorsector!

Wil jij een sleutelrol spelen in de realisatie van belangrijke spoorprojecten? Dan komen we graag met je in contact! Solliciteer direct of neem voor meer informatie contact op met Jeffrey Smit, bereikbaar via 06-41176005 of Of neem contact op met onze directeur; Jaap van der Star. Hij kan je meer vertellen over de inhoud van deze functie. Je kan hem bereiken op 06-53599848

Highlights

Wil jij werken aan uitdagende spoorprojecten en een directe bijdrage leveren aan de duurzame mobiliteit van Nederland? Bij Dura Vermeer Railinfra krijg je de kans. Lees verder voor meer informatie

raw.excerpt: Workiva’s Technical Account Managers (TAMs) are a critical part of our customer-facing team, serving both federal and enterprise accounts.
raw.description:
Workiva’s Technical Account Managers (TAMs) are a critical part of our customer-facing team, serving both federal and enterprise accounts. The TAM acts as the primary point of contact and strategic advisor for high-profile customers, managing all aspects of product support for the customer from issue resolution to proactive planning, guidance and prevention. This role blends account management strategies with technical advanced support skills in order to act as a trusted advisor for our customers by navigating complex customer needs, delivering exceptional support, and driving platform adoption.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the main liaison for strategic customers to ensure timely response and resolution delivery

  • Maximize and enable our customers' ROI on the Workiva Platform while ensuring the highest levels of security and compliance, particularly for federal clients and those requiring confidentiality of their data

  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including executives, servicing as the main contact for all support related issues

  • Manage and report on performance against service level agreements (SLAs), creating action plans when SLAs are not being met

  • Facilitate regular customer conference calls and meetings to ensure continuous information flow and timely updates

  • Oversee escalations and deliver Root Cause Analysis for high priority cases

  • Advocate for customers internally by providing feedback to various Workiva teams included, but not limited to, Sales, Services, Marketing, Product, and Engineering

  • Work with Sales and Customer Success as needed to aid in upcoming renewals and achieve revenue retention targets

  • Collaborate with internal teams to drive adoption through effective onboarding, training, and support

  • Ensure technical health of the platform through business reviews or consultations

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge and certifications of the Workiva Platform to meet the evolving needs of customers

What You’ll Need

Minimum Requirements

  • Typically requires a minimum of 6 years of related experience

  • Bachelor’s degree

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust level of security clearance for all Federal customers

  • Experience with systems like Splunk, Jira, Confluence, AWS Services, and/or Zendesk preferred

  • Experience in a Technical Account Management or similar role in a SaaS company preferred

  • Experience with federal customers and knowledge of government requirements preferred

  • Experience in Accounting, Finance, database support or system/network administration preferred

  • Experience working with product management or product development in a software company

  • Intermediate to advanced experience with one or more of the following technologies required

    • Database technologies, e.g.: Microsoft SQL, Oracle SQL, PostgreSQL, RedShift

    • Programming interfaces and API technologies e.g.: Restful API, SOAP, WSDL and OpenAPI spec

    • Basic understanding of XML/JSON and their structures - script languages e.g.: Python, Java, Node .js, PowerShell, .BAT/Shell, Perl

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, not in a company office

  • Willingness to travel (up to 10% of the time) for team and customer meetings, and corporate events

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $106,000.00 - $185,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented student in Computer Science or a related field to join our Data Acquisition Team as the entry point to WEX’s Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) platform — here we are responsible for ingesting, validating, and orchestrating raw data from dozens of internal systems and third-party providers. How you’ll make an impact:

  • Design and implement AI-assisted workflows that directly optimize our production environment. Apply specification-driven development and declarative system design to build highly scalable, model-driven solution.

  • Work with big data technologies: Gain experience with big data tools and technologies, including data ingestion, processing, and analysis.

  • Collaborate with experts: Partner with experienced engineers and researchers to brainstorm solutions, overcome technical challenges, and contribute to innovative projects.

  • Present your work: Share your research findings and project outcomes with the team and stakeholders.

Experience you’ll bring:

  • Educational Foundation: Pursuing a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated programming experience, including the ability to write, read, test, debug, and troubleshoot code.

  • Hands-on experience developing software or programming solutions through professional experience, internships, academic coursework or school projects, research, personal/self-directed coding projects, or other hands-on programming experience.

  • Hands-on experience using at least one programming language, such as Java, Python, C++, C#, JavaScript, or another relevant language.

  • Ability to apply programming concepts and problem-solving skills to develop effective and maintainable solutions, with the ability to provide examples of this work upon request.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently apply programming skills to solve problems or build software through coursework, projects, internships, research, personal coding projects, or other hands-on work.

  • Hands-on experience working with data, including data analysis, manipulation, or visualization.

Preferred Skills:

  • Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and core DevOps practices.

  • Data & AI Infrastructure:Exposure to data processing (SQL, ELT, data warehousing) and foundational AI/ML concepts.

  • Modern Development Methodologies:Interest in Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and leveraging AI assistants to write structured, high-quality code.

  • Open Source:Prior contributions to open-source projects or academic publications are a plus.

  • Problem-Solving & Learning: Solution-oriented mindset with a strong desire to master scalable system design and explore new technologies.

  • Communication & Collaboration:Ability to articulate technical ideas clearly and work effectively within a team.

  • Customer Focus: Driven to turn business problems into practical, user-centric software solutions.

raw.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Software EngineerOverview:
Software engineers working on Mastercard’s Open Banking platform play a key role in the development and maintenance of the products that secure high quality connectivity to banks across Europe. Building on the strong foundation of our state-of-the-art bank connectivity APIs, the engineers create turn-key solutions that take the burden of handling account information and payment initiation services from customers that want to spend their efforts building great products that leverage the full potential of the Open Banking standard.

Role:

Open Banking engineers work at the bleeding edge of the account information and payment initiation technologies, often solving problems that are yet to be tackled within the industry in areas of API security, data accessibility, processing, and analysis. You will be joining a group of highly skilled individuals working together as a team to push the limits of what is possible to achieve with open banking.

You will have many colleagues around different countries, with your nearest peers being located primarily in Denmark and Poland.

About you:
We are looking for motivated individuals that are looking to be a part of a newly formed team comprised of both industry veterans as well as newcomers. What they all have in common is the understanding that in order to achieve great things, being able to work together as a team is a must.
You will be spending most of your time in the Microsoft domain, meaning APIs built in C# with .NET (latest version) and ASP.NET deployed to the cloud (Azure). Deep knowledge of at least some of these areas is a requirement. However, we believe that learning is a part of the job, so if you for example have extensive experience building ASP.NET apps, but not in the cloud, do not hesitate to apply regardless.

Beyond that, it is expected that you have experience building software using modern development standards, meaning it should not come as a surprise that we utilise all the tools at our disposal from standard ticketing systems (Azure DevOps), VCS, test automation, to CI/CD pipelines.
Additionally, if you have experience with provisioning infrastructure as code (Terraform) as well as interest in computer security (Certificates, HTTPS) it would be a great benefit. Prior experience from working in closely regulated industries (financial, medical, etc.) is welcome, but not required.

And above all, we hope that you love solving problems!

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Job Title: Director, Advertising Promotion (Remote-Eligible)

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description

General Summary:

The Advertising Promotion Director is responsible for providing strategic and tactical regulatory direction and support for the management of review and approval of product, pipeline and disease state communications for Vertex product(s) and/or Development program(s), including promotional and non-promotional materials and communications from varied stakeholders including Commercial, Medical, Corporate Communications and Public Affairs. This role works collaboratively and cross-functionally in the development and implementation of processes that support meeting business objectives and meet regulatory requirements.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provides direction and expertise as a Regulatory expert on region/country regulations and requirements governing product promotion and related communications, including pipeline and disease state communications
  • Serves as Regulatory reviewer on Communications Review Committee (CRC) and Medical Review Committee (MRC), and as Global Regulatory Affairs Advertising and Promotion (GRA-AP) representative on program and other cross-functional teams
  • Functions as Chair of CRC for assigned product(s) and therapeutic area(s), leading discussions between Regulatory, Legal, Medical, Commercial and other stakeholders to reach consensus CRC decisions
  • As Regulatory Reviewer, assesses the regulatory context and provide regulatory interpretations of applicable guidance and/or regulations or regulatory precedents, including requirements related to submission of material to Health Authority (HA) and interact with HA, as applicable
  • Enhances collaboration across a matrixed organization while developing and maintaining constructive relationships with CRC stakeholders
  • Provides direction and input for development products reflective of promotional considerations
  • Provides direction to ensure that changes in product labeling are carried into promotional materials in accordance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
  • Provides leadership and direction for cross-functional efforts to develop and update procedures and guidelines related to CRC processes
  • Monitors and interprets advertising and promotion regulations and guidelines to support successful and compliant marketing of Vertex products; assesses impact on Vertex business and stakeholders
  • Leads training sessions as needed with stakeholders

Knowledge and Skills:

  • High level of applied knowledge of applicable Health Authority codes, laws, regulations, guidance, and industry standards related to advertising and promotional communications about prescription drugs, devices (if applicable), and investigational treatments
  • In-depth understanding of clinical study design and statistical analyses in assessment of promotional claims
  • Familiarity with labeling regulations and global promotional review
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to lead, interact with, influence, resolve conflict and drive consensus among individuals from a variety of cultures and disciplines

  • Demonstrates the ability to effectively adopt and leverage emerging technologies, including AI-driven tools, and maintains a continuous learning mindset to strengthen regulatory strategy, decision-making, and operational efficiency.

  • Proactively remains up to date on advances with technology, AI, automation, competitive intelligence and changes in the regulatory environment.

  • A solutions-driven mindset, with skills in complex reasoning and risk management assessments
  • Excellent communication skills (oral and written), project management and presentation skills
  • Pharmaceutical industry and regulatory ad/promo experience, including managing launch campaigns and interacting with Health Authorities

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant/scientific discipline or a related field
  • Typically requires 10 years of experience or the equivalent combination of education and experience

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

Pay Range:

$188,000 - $282,000

Disclosure Statement:

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

Flex Designation:

Remote-Eligible

Flex Eligibility Status:

In this Remote-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
1. Remote: work remotely five days per week and come into the office on occasion – you’re always welcome on-site; or select
2. Hybrid: work remotely up to two days per week; or select
3. On-Site: work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

raw.description:
ABOUT US

321 is a creative marketing agency using strategic data to create the kinds of meaningful moments that connect, inspire, and engage. We thrive on collaboration, agility, and heart — and we're powered by teammates who focus on what matters, bring proactive solutions to the table, and take full ownership of their work. We believe great work starts with great people, and we're looking for one more to join the team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Client Account Strategist (Digital) - Insurance Specialist at 321, you will play a dual role as both a strategic leader and digital marketing expert with deep expertise in the insurance sector. You will own high-level client relationships and performance outcomes while leveraging specialized digital execution expertise across paid campaigns, CRM initiatives, and full-funnel customer strategies tailored to the unique dynamics of home and auto insurance marketing.

You'll act as a key driver of business success for our insurance clients—helping them achieve growth through sophisticated digital marketing strategies that navigate the complexities of insurance consumer behavior, regulatory considerations, seasonal enrollment periods, and long consideration cycles. You understand the nuances of insurance product marketing, from awareness and quote generation to policy conversion and retention.

This role is at the intersection of senior client leadership, digital marketing mastery, insurance industry expertise, and team mentorship. You'll bring deep experience in multi-channel digital strategy, campaign execution, CRM, customer journey planning specific to insurance sales cycles, and be energized by the evolving role of AI and automation in marketing innovation.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Strategic Client Leadership for Insurance Accounts

  • Serve as the senior lead across insurance-focused client accounts (home, auto, and related product lines), acting as their trusted partner and business advisor
  • Develop and guide comprehensive digital marketing strategies that span paid media, CRM, content, and automation—with a focus on quote generation, policy sales, and customer lifetime value
  • Lead high-level planning meetings, campaign reviews, and growth strategy sessions with insurance clients and internal teams
  • Translate complex insurance business objectives and product portfolios into actionable digital strategies and communicate them clearly across creative, media, and development teams
  • Navigate insurance industry regulations, compliance requirements, and marketing guidelines in all strategic recommendations
  • Understand and optimize for insurance-specific metrics including quote-to-bind ratios, cost per policy, customer acquisition cost by product line, and lifetime value by customer segment
  • Actively apply AI-driven tools and techniques to optimize campaign performance, improve personalization, and streamline workflows

Advanced Digital Strategy & Execution - Insurance Focus

  • Lead digital campaign planning and audience targeting strategies across platforms including Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube with insurance-specific audience segmentation (homeowners, renters, auto insurance shoppers, bundle seekers, etc.)
  • Own the development and optimization of sophisticated customer journey strategies tailored to insurance purchase behavior—from initial awareness through quote comparison, application, binding, and policy renewal
  • Develop multi-touch attribution models that account for the extended consideration cycles typical in insurance purchasing decisions
  • Design and execute strategies for seasonal insurance marketing opportunities (moving season, back-to-school auto insurance, weather-related home insurance awareness, open enrollment periods)
  • Create targeting strategies that leverage life event triggers (home purchases, vehicle purchases, marriage, relocation, policy renewal dates)
  • Define campaign KPIs, budget allocations, and messaging priorities based on insurance product goals and advanced market insights
  • Oversee planning and execution of lead generation campaigns optimized for insurance quote funnels and comparison shopping behavior
  • Ensure campaigns align with key performance metrics across the funnel—from awareness and quote requests to policy conversion and retention
  • Create and present strategic campaign briefs, recommendations, and comprehensive post-campaign performance analysis with insurance-specific benchmarking

Insurance Industry Expertise & Market Intelligence

  • Maintain deep understanding of home and auto insurance market dynamics, competitive landscape, and consumer behavior trends
  • Stay current on insurance industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging marketing best practices
  • Understand insurance product positioning including coverage types, policy features, pricing strategies, and competitive differentiation
  • Leverage knowledge of insurance shopping behaviors including multi-carrier comparison, quote aggregators, direct-to-consumer models, and agent-assisted channels
  • Apply expertise in insurance customer personas including first-time buyers, policy switchers, bundle seekers, and renewal customers
  • Develop strategies that address insurance-specific objections and decision factors (price sensitivity, coverage concerns, claims reputation, customer service quality)

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor other Client Strategists and Digital Account Strategists, providing strategic insight, digital-first thinking, insurance industry knowledge, and ongoing guidance
  • Partner with department leadership to improve internal digital tools, workflows, and collaboration between teams
  • Lead by example in digital best practices, strategic thinking, and insurance marketing expertise
  • Share insurance industry insights and best practices across the broader agency team

Advanced Funnel & CRM Strategy - Insurance Applications

  • Guide development of sophisticated CRM campaigns including email journeys, automations, and advanced list segmentation via tools like High Level, HubSpot, or Salesforce tailored to insurance sales cycles
  • Design nurture sequences for insurance quote abandonment, policy renewal reminders, cross-sell opportunities (home + auto bundling), and retention campaigns
  • Develop re-engagement strategies for lapsed policyholders and quote non-converters
  • Analyze customer behavior and engagement data to provide strategic recommendations for optimization across the insurance customer lifecycle
  • Identify and define high-impact opportunities to improve quote-to-policy conversion, reduce abandonment, and increase multi-policy household penetration
  • Create CRM segmentation strategies based on policy type, coverage level, claims history, renewal timing, and household characteristics
  • Lead creative brief development and guide internal teams on translating advanced insurance-focused digital strategy into execution

Performance Analytics & Optimization

  • Monitor, analyze, and collaborate to optimize campaign and account performance through advanced data-driven decision making with insurance-specific KPIs
  • Track performance across all digital channels using platforms like Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, and ad platforms with custom insurance conversion tracking
  • Build and present comprehensive monthly performance reports with clear KPIs including cost per quote, quote-to-bind rate, cost per policy, customer lifetime value, retention rate, and strategic optimization tactics
  • Provide actionable insights that drive continual improvement and strategic evolution based on insurance market benchmarks
  • Optimize campaigns for insurance-specific conversion events including quote starts, quote completions, application submissions, and policy bindings

Client Success & Agency Growth

  • Build lasting client relationships rooted in digital marketing results, transparency, forward-thinking strategy, and deep insurance industry knowledge
  • Lead onboarding for new insurance accounts and projects to ensure strategic alignment and operational clarity
  • Collaborate with business development to identify growth opportunities and scope new digital initiatives within insurance and related verticals
  • Own revenue planning, budget tracking, and invoicing in coordination with account and project teams
  • Position 321 as a thought leader in insurance marketing innovation

WHAT YOU HAVE

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 6+ years in digital marketing strategy, client strategy, account management, or marketing consulting—preferably in an agency environment
  • 3+ years of direct experience marketing insurance products, specifically home and auto insurance (personal lines focus required)
  • Demonstrated success managing high-value insurance client relationships and leading complex digital marketing campaigns in the insurance sector
  • Deep understanding of insurance sales funnels, quote generation processes, and policy conversion optimization

raw.description:
Unit8, founded in 2017, is a high-tech, dynamic Swiss leader in AI and data analytics consulting, renowned for solving complex challenges in traditional industries such as automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing, and pharma. Our esteemed partnerships with industry giants like Palantir, NVIDIA, and OpenAI underscore our commitment to excellence. With over 300 successful projects and a team of 160+ talented professionals across Switzerland, Poland, Spain and Germany, we are now expanding our footprint to the USA.

Unit8 is dedicated to driving AI adoption in non-digital industries, accelerating their digital transformation. We invest in projects that matter, including pro-bono initiatives and "engineering for good" causes.

Requirements

About You

We are looking for an experienced Deployment Strategist with deep technical and operational expertise in Palantir Foundry to join our US team.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of strategy, data engineering, and product ownership. You are not just implementing software; you are re-architecting how our clients make decisions. You will enter complex environments where data is siloed and workflows are broken, and you will be the primary catalyst for turning that chaos into a structured, value-generating engine.

You will act as the translator between business intent and technical execution. You will get your hands dirty in the Ontology and pipelines while simultaneously guiding C-level stakeholders through their digital transformation journey.

What You'll do

Drive Value with Foundry

  • Lead the end-to-end implementation of data-centric solutions using Palantir Foundry. You will architect Ontologies, design pipelines, and build user-facing applications (Workshop/Slate) that solve tangible business problems.
  • Move beyond simple dashboards; build operational applications that allow users to write back to the system and close the feedback loop.

Navigate Ambiguity

  • Embed yourself within client teams to identify the "unknown unknowns." You will deconstruct high-level business goals into concrete technical roadmaps.
  • Take ownership of open-ended problems in unstructured environments. You define what "good" looks like when the client isn't sure yet.

Bridge the Gap

  • Collaborate with Unit8 Data Scientists and Engineers to ensure the backend logic supports the frontend reality.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to the client, challenging assumptions and ensuring that the technology we build is actually adopted by the end-users on the ground.

Expand & Mentor

  • Help shape Unit8’s US presence by contributing to business development, scoping new engagements, and demonstrating the power of Foundry to prospective clients.
  • Mentor junior team members on best practices regarding data governance, system architecture, and client management.

What You Bring

The Experience

  • Foundry Mastery: You have significant, hands-on experience delivering projects within Palantir Foundry. You are comfortable with the Ontology, Code Repositories, Pipeline Builder, and application building tools (Workshop/Slate).
  • Consulting & Strategy: 3+ years of experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, or a similar operational role where you owned the delivery of data products.
  • Track Record: You can point to specific examples where you took a vague business problem and turned it into a deployed software solution that generated value.

The Mindset

  • First-Principles Thinker: You don't just follow the process; you question it. You drill down to the root cause of a problem rather than patching symptoms.
  • Grit and Humility: You are willing to do whatever it takes to make the project succeed, whether that’s presenting a roadmap to a VP or debugging a failed build late at night. The outcome matters more to you than the title.
  • User-Obsessed: You understand that the best code is useless if no one uses it. You prioritize user experience and workflow integration over technical complexity.

The Essentials

  • Proficiency in Palantir Foundry & AIP
  • Experience with programming/scripting, such as Python and/or SQL.
  • Understanding of distributed computing concepts (Spark) and modern data stack architectures.
  • Willingness to travel to client sites across the US as needed to drive implementation success.

Benefits

What we offer?

  • High-Stakes Work: You will work on critical projects that transform how major industries operate.
  • A "Builder" Culture: We are not a slide-deck consultancy. We build things that work. You will be surrounded by engineers and data scientists who share your passion for execution.
  • Pioneering role and autonomy: As a key member of our US growth, you will have the freedom to shape how we deliver value in this new market.
  • Groundbreaking Opportunity: You will play a pivotal role in establishing Unit8's footprint in the USA, driving the growth and impact of our operations in this emerging market.
  • Rewarding Package: The estimated base salary range for this position is $130,000 – $180,000. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes an annual bonus based on individual and company performance. We also offer a 401(k) retirement plan and comprehensive health insurance. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and skills.

Unit8 is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity drives innovation and enhances our ability to serve our clients effectively. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our mission.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Tidio is the customer service platform that aligns AI and people, so businesses can scale without losing trust or the human touch. Our goal is to help entrepreneurs grow by making customer service more efficient while keeping it helpful.

Working at Tidio means impacting thousands of companies and millions of their users. But our clients are not the only ones who can grow with us. By joining Tidio, you can grow, too!

Lyro, one of our flagship AI products,is to customer service what Claude is to AI — a customer service platform that lets teams build, test, and deploy customer service agents anywhere.

A few facts about us:

  • Our product is one of the world's leading AI customer service solutions, and our goal is to become no. 1

As a Financial Controller, you’ll be part of our six-person Finance & Operations team, collaborating closely with another Financial Controller and reporting directly to the Head of Finance.

Your main focus will be on financial controlling, reporting, planning, analysis, and cost management. You’ll make sure the numbers are accurate and reliable, monitor financial performance, and help the business understand what is behind the results.

As the Financial Controller, you will:

  • Control the financial operations of the company.

  • Analyze financial data, build financial models, and draw conclusions and recommendations to improve business performance.

  • Monitor product and customer profitability.

  • Create management reports and financial forecasts.

  • Manage the budgeting process and control budget realization, with close monitoring and anticipation of budget overruns.

  • Participate in monthly reporting meetings with C-level stakeholders, presenting the conclusions from your analysis and preparing meeting notes.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to help them understand cost variances and the financial implications of their decisions.

  • Manage app spend, with a high focus on LLM-related costs.

  • Control accounting and bookkeeping functions.

  • Coordinate day-to-day document acceptance and the payments process with the accounting team, and assist other teams with related financial matters.

  • Prepare ad hoc financial analyses and reports.

  • Improve financial policies and procedures.

  • Work closely with the other Financial Controller to ensure smooth ownership of the controlling function.

Requirements

You are the perfect fit if you:

  • Bring at least 2/3 years of experience in a similar role.

  • Have strong experience in management reporting and financial model preparation.

  • Demonstrate advanced analytical skills and proficiency in MS Office tools, especially Excel, Power Query, and VBA.

  • Have strong financial expertise and an interest in understanding the business behind the numbers.

  • Have the ability to investigate financial results, identify key drivers and variances, and draw clear conclusions from your analysis.

  • Feel comfortable working with business stakeholders and explaining financial topics in a clear, practical way.

  • Take a proactive, methodical, and hands-on approach, constantly looking for ways to improve how things work and bring new ideas.

  • Feel comfortable in a fast-paced environment and can easily adapt to changing priorities.

  • Have fluent English for day-to-day business and finance communication.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in SaaS or Big 4;

  • Solid understanding of financial regulations and compliance.

We would like to offer you:

  • An independent role with a strong impact on the company's growth.

  • Work in a small, flat structure, with real decision-making power and a shared passion for purpose-driven work.

  • Great development opportunities - learn by solving real, high-stakes challenges on the job, supported by company-sponsored courses and conferences.

  • Remote or hybrid work model from our Warsaw/Szczecin office.

  • 26 days off guaranteed per year.

  • Sport & wellness benefit - no extra charge.

Senior Statistical Programmer (Client-dedicated - China only)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Uses SAS or other software to develop custom programming code to generate summary tables, data listings, graphs and derived datasets as specified in the statistical analysis plan and programming specifications.
  • Works to ensure that outputs meet quality standards and project requirements. Performs validation programming and works with other Programmers, Biostatisticians, and other project team members to resolve discrepancies or any findings. Keeps project team members informed of programming progress and issues requiring their attention. Follow applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
  • Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, testing, and verification/quality control documents and programs ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects at a time, sets goals based on priorities from management, and adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload. Develops specifications for datasets and outputs of any complexity according to statistical and sponsor requirements. Anticipates and addresses potential programming issues, reflects forethought, establishes the basis for efficient programming and accurately defines all variables to be accepted by peer review and sponsor/requestor with little rework.
  • Prepares in advance for internal meetings, contributes ideas, and demonstrates respect for opinions of others.
  • Conducts effective internal meetings (appropriate in format, frequency and attendance). Distributes relevant information in advance. Ensures minutes are promptly and accurately distributed. Follows action items through to completion, and maintains order and focus of meetings, working toward consensus. Displays willingness to work with others and assist with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business. Negotiates and establishes accurate time estimates for completion of study programming activities with internal team members and statistical programming management, and completes project programming activities within timeframe allotted.
  • Acts as the lead statistical programmer. Directs the programming activities of other programming personnel and monitors progress on programming deliverables. Reviews project documentation such as Statistical Analysis Plan, mock shells, programming specifications, annotated CRFs, and SAS database design. Provides feedback to the appropriate project team members which reflects forethought and reduces inefficiencies in programming activities.
  • Participates in sponsor meetings, kickoff meetings, and bid defense meetings as statistical programming representative, as required by sponsor. Contributes to the mentoring of programming personnel through developing training courses, presenting training materials, reviewing work, and providing feedback or guiding new associates in process. Transfers deliverables. Performs other work-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree, preferably in a scientific or statistical discipline; in lieu of degree, an equivalent combination of education and demonstrated programming experience.
  • Extensive programming experience in SAS or other required software, preferably in a clinical trial environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Night Shift Project Manager — Localization, Translation, Interpreting & Sales

Company: Day Translations, Inc.

Position type: Full-time

Location: Remote — worldwide

Schedule: U.S. nighttime hours. Exact hours and applicable U.S. time zone will be confirmed during hiring.

Day Translations is a global translation and interpreting company. We help individuals, organizations, and businesses communicate worldwide through accurate translations, localization, interpreting, and tailored language solutions.

We are seeking a full-time Project Manager with strong sales experience and knowledge of localization, translation, and interpreting to join our night team.

This position combines project management, client service, and sales. You will manage language projects from inquiry through delivery, convert inquiries into paying clients, close deals with large interpreting clients, and help businesses sign up for phone interpreting services through Day Interpreting.

The ideal candidate can confidently lead client conversations, explain our services, negotiate effectively, and close business while keeping projects organized and on schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Manage localization, translation, and interpreting projects from initial inquiry and quoting through scheduling, delivery, and completion.
  • Lead sales conversations with prospective clients, understand their needs, recommend appropriate services, and close deals.
  • Pursue and close large interpreting opportunities, including ongoing service agreements with businesses and organizations.
  • Guide clients through signing up for Day Interpreting’s phone interpreting services, including explaining the platform, pricing, account setup, and next steps.
  • Conduct client calls, presentations, and platform demonstrations to support sales and onboarding.
  • Follow up proactively on inquiries, quotes, proposals, and pending agreements to move opportunities toward a decision.
  • Build relationships with decision-makers and identify opportunities for repeat business, expanded services, and long-term partnerships.
  • Prepare accurate quotes, proposals, project budgets, and achievable timelines.
  • Coordinate localization projects involving websites, software, applications, and digital content, including file preparation, linguist assignments, review, and delivery.
  • Coordinate translation projects, including translator and editor assignments, proofreading, formatting, and final quality checks.
  • Arrange on-site, telephone, and video interpreting assignments, confirming language pairs, subject matter, dates, time zones, locations, and technical requirements.
  • Confirm interpreter availability and readiness, manage scheduling changes, and arrange replacements when needed.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to client inquiries by phone, email, and chat.
  • Source qualified language professionals through approved freelancer databases and negotiate rates and deadlines.
  • Track project budgets and costs to maintain quality and profitability.
  • Maintain accurate project records in Plunet and sales activity in the company’s designated systems.
  • Monitor progress, resolve client and freelancer questions, and escalate urgent concerns when necessary.
  • Communicate actively with colleagues and provide clear handover notes between shifts.
  • Follow company policies, confidentiality requirements, and quality procedures.

Requirements

  • Strong sales experience, including a demonstrated ability to negotiate and close deals with large business clients.
  • Experience selling interpreting services or other business-to-business services, with the ability to manage longer sales conversations and multiple decision-makers.
  • Confidence conducting sales calls, presenting solutions, handling objections, following up, and asking for the sale.
  • Ability to explain phone interpreting services clearly and guide clients through Day Interpreting sign-up and onboarding.
  • Solid knowledge of localization and translation workflows, including project scoping, file requirements, linguist coordination, quality assurance, and delivery.
  • Understanding of interpreting services and logistics, including on-site, telephone, and video interpreting.
  • Experience in project management and customer service, preferably within the language services industry.
  • Familiarity with CAT tools such as Smartcat, memoQ, or Trados Studio.
  • Experience with Plunet or similar project management systems is preferred.
  • Advanced written and spoken English at a native or C1 level, plus fluency in at least one additional language.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, sales opportunities, and deadlines.
  • Excellent cross-cultural communication, professionalism, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and remain proactive and responsive throughout the night shift.
  • Reliable internet access and a quiet workspace suitable for client calls and demonstrations.
  • Consistent availability for full-time work during the assigned U.S. nighttime schedule.
  • A university degree in Business Administration, Translation, Localization, or a related field is preferred.

Professional Commitment

This position requires your full professional commitment during scheduled working hours. Job stacking and conflicting concurrent employment are not permitted. We monitor productivity and work activity, and any undisclosed conflicting employment may result in termination.

How to Apply

To be considered, you must complete both steps:

  1. Submit your application and provide complete answers to every application question. Include examples of your sales results, large client deals you have closed, and experience managing language projects.
  2. Complete the Emotional Intelligence and Wonderlic assessments after submitting your application.

Both steps are required to move forward in the evaluation process.

Candidates may be asked to complete a background check before hiring.

All application questions are mandatory. Incomplete or insufficient answers may result in disqualification or a request for clarification.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform Experience & Insights
raw.excerpt: Who we areHungerRush is a leading provider of integrated restaurant solutions.
raw.description:
Who we are

HungerRush is a leading provider of integrated restaurant solutions. HungerRush 360 is our flagship cloud POS system that makes it easier to delight guests, drive loyalty, and manage restaurants from anywhere. The all-in-one system integrates digital ordering, delivery, customer engagement, restaurant management, and payment processing with flexible software designed to give operators more insight into their customers, more control over their operations, and more power to profitably grow their business.

Position overview

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the reporting, analytics, and cross-product experience layer of HUB, spanning point-of-sale, the HUB Dashboard, and the Mobile HUB app, the primary tool for managing a business on the go. You'll balance the distinct needs of SMB operators, franchise owners, and corporate multi-brand stakeholders within one coherent experience, operating as an empowered product leader accountable for outcomes, not output, in close partnership with Design and Engineering.

This is a modernization, transformation, and 0-to-1 role. The platform is mid-evolution, with real legacy constraints and a company-wide focus on platform stability. Success means untangling hard, constrained problems, sequencing complex changes well, and knowing when to simplify or retire functionality rather than add to it. The strongest candidates are puzzle-solvers who find that energizing, not limiting.

Key responsibilities

Product Operating Model & Continuous Discovery

  • Operate as part of an empowered product team accountable for outcomes: success means problems solved, not features shipped.
  • Run continuous discovery, staying in regular direct contact with operators, franchise owners, and corporate brand teams to validate problems before committing engineering investment.
  • Partner in a product trio with Design and Engineering leads, sharing ownership of the roadmap and its tradeoffs.
  • Actively look for opportunities to simplify, consolidate, or retire legacy functionality, treating subtraction as a deliberate product tool.

Commercial Ownership

  • Understand the pricing and packaging implications of platform capabilities, factoring commercial tradeoffs into roadmap decisions.
  • Partner with Sales and Commercial teams to position and package new capabilities in ways that support the business model.

AI-Native Product Practice

  • Use AI tools throughout the discovery-to-delivery workflow, from research synthesis to spec drafting and prototyping, to move faster without sacrificing rigor.
  • Identify and champion opportunities to build AI-powered capabilities directly into HUB, turning numbers into automated recommendations for operators.
  • Define the data foundation strategy, quality, structure, and governance, that enables reliable reporting today and AI-driven insights tomorrow.

Platform & Experience Ownership

  • Own the reporting and business insights capability set across every channel of the platform.
  • Own the HUB Dashboard and HUB on-the-go (Mobile) end-to-end, staying deep enough to demo it, train an operator, and troubleshoot a live issue directly.
  • Ensure HUB feels like one unified product, even where individual modules (configuration, menu, loyalty, coupons) are owned by other teams.

Persona-Balanced Product Design

  • Design experiences for SMB operators, franchise owners, and corporate brand stakeholders, engaging directly with each to understand their distinct needs and levels of oversight.
  • Prioritize and own a roadmap that scales from single-location simplicity to multi-brand, multi-unit complexity.

Data Integrity & Financial Accuracy

  • Own the accuracy of metrics that feed financial and franchise-facing calculations.
  • Ensure consistent reporting logic across surfaces so operators and franchise partners trust one source of truth, and refine live reporting based on usage data once features ship.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Communication

  • Partner directly with Engineering leadership on architectural decisions, shaping technical direction alongside execution.
  • Coordinate with other product teams and departments, representing this role in cross-team planning and leading product marketing efforts and go-to-market for owned products.
  • Communicate roadmap, trade-offs, and progress to Product leadership, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success, rallying the team around the vision and strategy, not just status updates.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of proven experience as a Product Manager in the SaaS industry, preferably within restaurant Tech or POS domains
  • Experience operating within an empowered product team model (Marty Cagan's Product Operating Model), owning outcomes and running continuous discovery as an equal partner with Design and Engineering.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for modernization and transformation work, with proven experience evolving a legacy or fragmented platform, including simplifying or retiring functionality as well as launching 0-to-1 capabilities.
  • Fluent with AI tools in daily product work (research, spec generation, data analysis, prototyping), and able to identify where AI belongs inside the product itself.
  • Experience defining a data foundation strategy that supports both reporting accuracy and downstream AI development.
  • Working understanding of pricing, packaging, and how product investment decisions connect to commercial outcomes.
  • Ability to design for multiple distinct user types within one cohesive product experience.
  • Comfortable working directly with engineering on data architecture and system dependencies.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proven track record delivering successful products in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Preferred

  • Experience in restaurant technology, POS, or another vertical SaaS platform.
  • Familiarity with franchise business models and multi-brand or multi-unit operator needs.
  • Experience designing for multiple personas, such as franchisor/franchisee or admin/end-user.
  • Experience shipping an AI-powered feature or capability in a live, customer-facing product.

Additional Information 

This position is open to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States, without sponsorship, either now or in the future. At this time, and in the foreseeable future, HungerRush is not able to support assistance with additional visa sponsorship, regarding this specific position.
